source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to AC circuits (PDF 92).

blocks.text: DC circuit ka bunyadi hissa resistor R hai jo current ya voltage qaboo karta hai, V = IR (Ohm ka qanoon). AC circuits ke bunyadi hisse resistor R, inductor L aur capacitor C hain, jo mil kar current aur voltage qaboo karte hain. In hisson wale AC circuits agle hisson mein hain: resistor (17.5), inductor (17.6 aur 17.7) aur capacitor (17.8), phir impedance (17.9) aur in ke majmue (17.10 se 17.13).

blocks.prompt: AC circuits ke teen bunyadi hisse batayein.
